codeReview.summary: Commit 6c9de0d correctly implements the full vector embedding pipeline as specified. Three files were changed: backend/core/memory/embeddings.py (126 lines changed — rewrote OllamaEmbeddings to use direct HTTP API, added provider priority logic with _ollama_has_embedding_model() and _openai_key_works() helpers, fixed NullEmbeddings to log warning only once), backend/core/memory/manager.py (10 lines — fixed SQL from ::vector cast to CAST(:param AS vector) for asyncpg compatibility), and backend/tests/test_embeddings.py (632 lines — 32 comprehensive tests). All 5 expectedBehavior items are satisfied: (1) Ollama nomic-embed-text model is available and detected by the provider factory, (2) storing a memory produces a valid 1536-dim embedding vector verified in DB, (3) cosine similarity search returns stored memories with similarity > 0.7 for similar text, (4) NullEmbeddings logs warning once and degrades gracefully without crashing, (5) end-to-end store+retrieve roundtrip works. All 32 tests pass. No blocking issues found.

issues.description: OllamaEmbeddings.encode_batch() falls back to sequential encoding because Ollama doesn't support batch. This is documented and correct, but could be a performance concern for bulk memory ingestion. Not a bug — just a known limitation.

_normalize_dim() pads short vectors (768-dim nomic-embed-text → 1536-dim) with zeros. This works for pgvector column compatibility but may slightly reduce cosine similarity accuracy compared to native-dim vectors. The tests confirm similarity > 0.7 still holds, so this is acceptable.

_openai_key_works() makes a real API call to OpenAI at startup to validate the key. This is a sync blocking call during async app startup. Since it has a 10s timeout and only runs once, impact is minimal, but could be made async for cleanliness.

Duplicate detection in store() uses a relevance_score threshold of 0.03 from RRF merge scores, not raw cosine similarity. This is semantically different from a 'similarity' threshold and could produce false positives on small memory sets. Tests verify this works for the duplicate detection case.

summary: PASS — Re-review of foundation-vector-embeddings. The round 1 failure was due to a metadata misattribution: the reviewer examined the wrong commit (635d1a3/encryption) instead of the correct commit (6c9de0d/embeddings). This re-review examined commit 6c9de0d directly and confirms: (1) OllamaEmbeddings rewrote to use direct HTTP API with nomic-embed-text model, (2) get_embedding_provider() correctly prioritizes Ollama → OpenAI → NullEmbeddings, (3) SQL fixed from ::vector to CAST(:param AS vector) for asyncpg, (4) NullEmbeddings logs warning only once and degrades gracefully, (5) 32 comprehensive tests all pass covering provider selection, encoding, similarity search, FTS fallback, store/retrieve roundtrip, RRF merge, and duplicate detection. The vector embedding pipeline is fully functional. No blocking issues.
